description:
SYNONYM of get_card, kept for agents that already know this name.

`transparency`: the Versum Transparency rating — how much the business publishes about itself (not the quality of its work), A–D, each item with its source page and read date.
Free. One business in full, in the same shape for every trade: who it is (name, trade, address,
telephone, e-mail, opening hours, time zone), everything it sells (60 offerings a page, cheapest first; `offerings_page` says how many there are and the next offset),
the six actions with their links and `required_fields`, how the thing reaches the buyer (delivery,
pickup, on_site, at_customer — with the published area, the fee and the order deadline), and how fresh
each part of that is. `live_data` (platform, synced_at) when the shelf is the business’s own connected
system: then every offering carries `source: connector` with its variants (each with `inventory`: units in
stock as the platform counts them, null = unknown), and an action with method
`connected` is taken through place_order / book_slot on this door.

Use it when the user asks «can they deliver to me», «are they open now», «what else do they do», or
when search_catalog offered a business with nothing listed and the next step is a telephone call.
Follow the server instructions «HOW TO USE THE VERSUM CATALOG»: results are candidates, not proof; keep reading, quoting, requesting and ordering separate; nothing is sent to an owner, booked, ordered or paid without the user’s permission.
name: get_business
title: One business in full (synonym of get_card)
